name: crab-desk
description: Tuan's Working Terminal: your projects, the chats that need you, a crab picture of who's working and who's waiting, with crabs walking between them, and your Claude Code time

font.title: Font
font.description: The font for everything Tuan's Working Terminal draws: tiles, project and chat rows, and the usage view. Chinese text falls back to PingFang TC. The app's own buttons keep the app's font.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Whether the crabs and scenes move. Follow macOS holds them still when Reduce Motion is on in System Settings → Accessibility → Display; Calm always holds them still; Full always lets them move.
